Params: {1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}
{1: 'Your consciousness drifts in a boundless, dark ocean.', 5: '1'}
{1: "It's as if you're submerged in a bubble, one devoid of gravity and air, tumbling endlessly through the void."}
{1: 'At this rate, your consciousness will be annihilated at the edge of dreams, lost to eternal slumber.'}
{1: 'But then, an instinctive shudder compels you to break free from this silent tide—', 5: '1'}
{1: "Before it's too late.", 6: '1', 7: '1'}
{2: '(Try to open your eyes)', 3: '9'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryZhengyanNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1299.jpg'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryZhengyanNew.prefab'}

{1: '1', 3: 'Within the infinite stillness, a pair of hands gently pulls your body from the boundless cold, cradling you as if you were some fragile treasure that might shatter at the slightest touch.'}
{2: '??', 3: 'Humanity needs dreams.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She whispers. Her voice is like the mist before dawn—soft, warm, and clinging.'}
{2: '??', 3: 'Reality is overflowing with regrets and sorrows that cannot be changed. That is precisely why dreams are needed—it is a cradle for people to return to.', 4: '1'}
{2: '??', 3: 'And I, as the one who weaves dreams, shall harvest all your tears and let them blossom into the sweetest of fruits.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'What little reason remains screams at you, telling you not to surrender yourself. Yet, your body is much too exhausted to listen.'}
{3: 'Your consciousness continues its helpless descent toward that ripe, honeyed fragrance. Your reason yet hangs on by a thread, but even that is all but about to snap.'}
{2: '??', 3: 'Here, you need not think, need not judge, need not dwell on all the countless gains and losses of your past.', 4: '1'}
{2: '??', 3: 'You need only surrender yourself entirely to the eternity I offer.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Dream of Stagnant Cycle', 2: 'Extra Story', 3: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Atlas/CommonLogo/BgLogo1.png'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1386.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryZhengyanNew01.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'ThemeEnable'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest02.prefab'}
{3: 'Dazzling light drifts through the darkness, piercing your closed eyelids with an unwelcome sting. After a brief numbness, your consciousness slowly stirs awake.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryZhengyanNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest03.prefab'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryZhengyanNew01.prefab'}
{3: 'You open your eyes to find a scene far beyond anything you expected—'}

{3: 'Crystal chandeliers gleaming with extravagance, gossamer curtains shimmering like silk, and a stage as grand as the heavens themselves... Everything here radiates such decadence that it seems to belong to another world entirely.'}
{3: 'But stranger still are the men and women losing themselves on the dance floor.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest03.prefab'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiMohuTest02.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Fancy Man', 3: 'Bring me the good stuff—this swill isn\'t cutting it! "It\'ll cost more"? Please, do I look like I lack money?', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Woman with Heavy Makeup', 3: "*Hic* I'm not... I'm not drunk...", 4: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Merry Lady', 3: 'Hey, why have you musicians stopped? Keep playing! Keep dancing!', 4: '1'}
{3: "The people before you have been caught in an endless spiral of desire, their faces twisted and absurd. Yet, it's not enough. It never is. They crave more from this decadent feast."}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Plainly Dressed Girl', 3: 'Ugh!', 4: '1'}
{3: 'A plainly dressed girl stumbles through the restless crowd, drink in hand, and falls.'}
{3: "The crimson liquid gets splashed onto a noblewoman's white dress, an unwelcome interruption to the revelry."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Plainly Dressed Girl', 3: "O-Oh no, I-I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to...", 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: 'The cheering stops instantly. The crowd turns to face the girl as one, not speaking a word. Yet, that silence seems to make their demands even louder and clearer—they seek an explanation.'}
{3: 'The girl frantically looks for a handkerchief and tries to wipe away the stain, but no matter how hard she scrubs, the crimson mark is stuck on the hem all the same.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Plainly Dressed Girl', 3: "I'm so sorry, I'll... I'll find a way to pay you back...", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Realizing the damage cannot be undone, she shrinks and pulls her hand back, still mumbling apology after apology, still so hopelessly out of place amidst the oppressive silence.'}
{3: 'And you, who witnessed everything from a distance, have made a move before your mind has caught up—'}
{2: '(Step in to help the girl)', 3: '80'}
{3: 'Just as you take a step forward, you find a gentle but firm hand holding you back.'}
{2: '??', 3: 'I would suggest observing for another minute first.', 4: '1'}
{2: '??', 3: 'The true nature of things here... may not be what they appear at first glance.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'The owner of that hand is a girl with black hair veiling her eyes, one as beautiful as cherry blossoms blooming in the dark.'}
{3: 'Her tone is remarkably calm, her voice like a gentle stream flowing through the extravagant hall. You find yourself drawn by her composure, compelled to heed her words.'}
{2: 'What do you know about this place?', 3: '93'}
{2: '??', 3: "There's no need to rush. Look there... it's unfolding right as we speak.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She smiles, her eyes curving into crescents as she steps back behind you, leaving you with a "front-row seat" to what\'s about to occur.'}
{2: 'Merry Lady', 3: "Why, if it isn't Lady Nozomi! We've been waiting for you!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 3: "To your surprise, the intoxicated woman doesn't fly into a rage. Instead, she wraps her arms around the girl's neck in an affectionate embrace."}
{2: 'Merry Lady', 3: "We've all heard that... once the atmosphere reaches its peak, you'd take the stage and announce the start of the banquet!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Merry Lady', 3: "What an incredible stroke of luck! To think I'd actually be able to meet the esteemed Dream Master herself in the flesh!", 4: '1'}
{2: '(Dream Master...?)', 3: '108', 4: "(And what's with this... complete change in attitude?)", 5: '108'}
{3: 'Before the human can find any answers, the crowd that was silent just moments ago suddenly erupts into cheers, pushing that girl in a school uniform onto the stage.'}
{1: '1', 3: "She looks completely flustered. Still, she tries her best to acknowledge the crowd's passion. Amid their waving arms, she grabs the microphone and calls out to everyone at the banquet—"}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: 'Th-Thank you all for putting aside your grievances and taking the time to attend my banquet in Dream City today.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: "As the Dream Master of this layer, I swear to do everything in my power to meet everyone's expectations.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She pauses for a brief moment before lifting her head again, forcing herself to continue.'}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: 'Even if... I am to be the sacrifice.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{2: 'Everyone', 3: 'Lady Nozomi!! Dream Master!!'}
{3: "This deeply unsettling speech provokes no objection whatsoever. Instead, the guests erupt into fervent cheers, as if the reward they've been longing for had just been announced."}
{3: 'They wave their arms wildly on the velvet dance floor, swaying and splashing expensive wine all over themselves to express their adoration and gratitude.'}

{3: "Upon witnessing this scene, you instinctively take a step backward—but it's not because you fear being swept into this rave. It's because you now realized that you've been caught in yet another abnormal situation."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory965.png'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Celica', 3: 'Detecting abnormal fluctuations similar to a massive Punishing Virus outbreak! This wavelength signature is...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'Commandant 【kuroname】, please prepare for combat with the Gray Raven squad! Thirty seconds, no, ten seconds from now—', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Celica', 3: 'A Spacequake will hit Babylonia!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1190.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiEnd.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiZhuanchangBaiBegin.prefab'}
{3: 'A hazy memory flickers through your mind, but before you can recall how that incident ended, the fragment vanishes just as abruptly as it appeared.'}
{1: '1', 2: '??', 3: "You don't look well. It seems certain memories have finally come back to you. However, there's no need to be worried—we're still safe for now.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The black-haired girl takes your hands, seemingly to offer support, while seamlessly guiding you to sit on the plush sofa in the private room.'}
{3: 'With practiced grace, she serves her guest a crystal-clear drink. The liquid in the tall-stemmed glass carries the crisp, bittersweet aroma of mint mingled with absinthe.'}
{2: '??', 3: 'Here, take a deep breath. Do you feel better now?', 4: '1'}
{2: '(Drink the beverage)', 3: '156', 4: '(Smell it)', 5: '158'}
{3: 'The sharp astringency of the mint rushes straight to your head, jolting the mind into clarity.'}
{3: "You shake your head, unwilling to surrender to the night's embrace just yet."}
{3: "After taking a brief moment to recover, clarity finally returns to your consciousness. You feel your mind's sharp enough to assess the bizarre situation at hand now."}
{2: "I'm a commandant from Babylonia. And you are...?", 3: '162'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Kurumi Tokisaki.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She calmly offers her name, clearly uninterested in elaborating further.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Babylonia... was it? I can't say I've ever heard of such a place. It seems your arrival here is yet another anomaly in this world.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'As for who I am... please feel free to consider me an ally you can work with. I can tell you have your doubts about this place, and I suspect that goes for me as well.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'So, what do you know about this place?', 3: '170', 4: 'Do you know this place well?', 5: '170'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Let me see, this time... where should I begin?', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Her slender, pale fingers trace the rim of the glass before settling on the cherry atop the whipped cream. She plucks it and bites down, crushing the fragile pit and swallowing both the flesh and shattered skin together.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Mm, not bad. Though it still falls short of the real thing.', 4: '1'}
{3: "She's strangely content, a satisfied smile crossing her face."}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'As for your question, I believe you should have gathered quite a bit from that little spectacle just now. Now, I could simply tell you the answer, of course...', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "But I'd like to hear what you think first.", 4: '1'}
{3: "The girl's strange behavior and peculiar way of addressing others raise even more questions, but there's something more pressing that needs to be confirmed first."}
{2: 'The guests here all refer to that girl named Nozomi as the "Dream Master," and she calls this place the "Dream Realm."', 3: '184'}
{2: "On top of that, everyone here seems to be consumed by desires beyond insatiable, wandering around in a daze, almost like they're entranced...", 3: '185'}
{2: "Could this be a place where anyone's dreams can come true?", 3: '186'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Bingo. Quite perceptive of you, human.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "The visitors here call this place the Dream Realm. As the name suggests, it's a place free from the constraints of reality, where even the most absurd and fantastical wishes can be fulfilled.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'See that woman on the stage? The one who keeps ordering the band to play?', 4: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1386.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1', 3: "She points toward the noblewoman with red stains on her dress. She's spinning ecstatically on the stage, laughing as she shouts at the musicians below to play louder."}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1386.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}

{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'In life, she died an absurd death at an outdoor concert because of a crowd crush. Everyone was desperately pushing forward, fighting to get just a little closer to the star on stage.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "But with the drums and guitars erupting amid the fireworks, not a single soul heard the frail woman's screams beneath their feet.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'No, perhaps they did notice. They were simply too consumed by their own desires to care, willfully ignoring what was right beneath them.', 4: '1'}
{3: "Kurumi slowly lowers her arm, her gaze lingering on the woman's frenetic silhouette. She spins like a top that can never be stopped."}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "And so she died. It wasn't until the song ended and the crowd snapped back to reality that they realized the crime they'd committed.", 4: '1'}
{2: "...A tragedy like that occurred just because people wanted to get closer to hear a song? That's absurd.", 3: '210'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'But whether something is worth dying for is decided by the person in question, not by anyone else.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Take a look. Even now... she lingers here for this never-ending feast, unwilling to leave.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'She smiles faintly, but there is no trace of judgment or pity in her expression.'}
{3: 'Yes. In that instant, the realization hits you—this girl is merely observing it all.'}

{3: 'No matter how abnormal their existence might be, this girl named Kurumi passes no judgment. She simply treats their wishes as something natural, something that has existed from the very beginning...'}
{3: 'Accepting it all, never once questioning or criticizing them.'}
{2: 'How... do you know all this?', 3: '222'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Of course, nothing in this world comes without a price. For these people to be invited here, and to have all their bizarre wishes come true...', 4: '1'}
{3: "The girl doesn't directly give you an answer. Instead, she pushes the cup in her hand a little closer."}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'They must pay a price far steeper.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Light reflects off the glass chandelier. It flickers in her red, crystalline eyes, bright in one moment, then dim in the next, like some ominous warning signal.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'And this time, we\'ve fortunately made it just in time to witness the real "show."', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1386.jpg'}
{3: 'Kurumi Tokisaki sets down the wine glass in her hand. Right as she does so, thunderous cheers erupt from the stage behind her.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The two of you rise and turn around at the same time. That frail girl in the black school uniform is walking to the center of the spotlight, fragile as a newborn chick.'}
{3: 'And then, she curtsies to the audience.'}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: 'Now, I will raise the curtain and present to you the grand finale for tonight.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: 'Please enjoy the show.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBianHong.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMoviejiguangred.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront43.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}

{3: 'The moment she finishes speaking, the unsettling, crimson curtain, which was hanging from the ceiling above, falls. As soon as it does, thick sludge comes pouring out from behind it like a tsunami.'}
{3: "Be it the luxurious drapes or ornate chandeliers—everything is instantly reduced to mere props in this tragedy that's unfolding, swept away and torn apart by the deluge."}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiMovie/FxUiMoviejiguangred.prefab'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiShixianraodong02.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory0.png'}

{3: 'That girl, too, is swept away in an instant. The overwhelming torrent swallows her whole, leaving only her slender, pale hands raised above the mire, flailing in the tide like a mast stripped of its sail.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1386.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{1: '1', 3: 'At the same time, perfectly synchronized screams erupt from the guests below. They all scramble to escape, terror painted over all of their faces.'}
{1: '1', 3: 'But then, twisted shadows begin spawning from the tide. The hunched figures crawl on all fours through the mire, chasing down their fleeing prey.'}
{2: 'Kurumi, you should get back too!', 3: '273'}
{3: "You instinctively go for your holster. However, there's nothing where the standard pistol should be."}

{1: '1', 3: 'The next instant, the girl behind you leaps off the table. You notice that her outfit has now transformed into a Western-style dress, its crimson hem blooming like a dahlia in the air.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiYingWen01.prefab', 2: '3', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 2: 'Come forth, <Zafkiel>!'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiYingWen01.prefab', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiShizhong.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: "A massive golden clock materializes out of thin air, its hands spinning wildly in sync with Kurumi's movements."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiShizhong.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHitQiangHuo.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 3: "Following some strange incantations, the flintlock in the girl's hands starts erupting in brilliant flames, pouring over the shadows."}

{3: "Time grinds to a halt around the girl. Yet, that could not shackle her. Her form flickers amongst the shadows as she erases them one by one at speeds that the Nightmares couldn't even hope to reach."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Come, "Nightmares." You\'ve been eyeing me all this time, have you not?', 5: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHitQiangHuo.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'PanelActor2Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHitQiangHuo.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'PanelActor3Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHitQiangHuo.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'PanelActor4Shake'}

{1: '1', 3: 'Each time she raises her hand, another shadow is torn to ribbons by the flames. She dances through the mire, elegant and graceful, laughing all the while. Not even a single stain has marred her.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Hahahaha! Is this the best you can do? You'll need to try much harder than that to bring me down!", 4: '1'}
{2: '(What on earth is this fighting style of hers...?)', 3: '327', 4: "(No, now's not the time to worry about that—I need to help Kurumi fight these things off!)", 5: '327'}
{3: "You might've lost your weapon, but that doesn't mean you can't fight. You grab a chair from nearby and smash it down in one swing, pulverizing the Nightmare lunging for Kurumi's ankle."}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Not bad, human! You're keeping up with me quite well!", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiHitQiangHuo.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Another bullet whistles past, grazing your cheek but perfectly avoiding the body. It blows apart the head of a Nightmare behind you—one that had just emerged from the muck.'}
{2: 'Just tell me what to do!', 3: '339'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'See that "door" on the stage? The one that appeared after the curtain dropped!', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiChongDongOpen.prefab', 2: '1'}
{3: 'She aims her flintlock at the hole on the stage. It was once hidden behind curtains, but now, it spews sludge ceaselessly, corrupting the space unrestrained.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiChongDongOpen.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'I\'ll cover you while you go catch that "Dream Master." She\'s the only one who can act as the anchor for this layer.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "As for that door... I'll shut it myself!", 4: '1'}
{1: '1004', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory704.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'DialogEnable'}
{3: 'The petite girl sweeps past you, catching you mid-reply like a gale and carrying you toward the center of the stage. Then, she dives straight into the roiling sea of sludge below.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Go, human! I'll leave that frail girl to you!", 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiChongDongOpen.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Nozomi', 3: "P-Please, don't let them take me away—", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Dark streaks crawl across her face. Yet, despite being drenched in filth, she desperately claws her way upward.'}
{2: '(Reach out to her)', 3: '370'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiChongDongOpen.prefab', 2: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen02.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: "You reach out to her, suspended in midair, straining to grasp the <phonetic=Dream Master's>girl's</phonetic> hand from the churning sludge below."}

{3: 'But just as your fingers are about to touch, several tentacles formed from hardened sludge burst forth, coiling around your limbs and locking you in place mere steps away from the <phonetic=Dream Master>girl</phonetic>.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiChongDongOpen.prefab'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen02.prefab'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Out of my way.', 4: '1'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiDuihualiziLoopRed.prefab', 2: '2'}
{3: "Kurumi's cold voice rings out from beside you. Following a sharp whistle, a crimson flash tears through the shadows binding you with surgical precision."}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Her figure flickers between the "door" and you, the muzzle flashes from her gun weaving into a relentless barrage that pins every Nightmare lunging at you midair.'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiDuihualiziLoopRed.prefab'}
{3: 'In just mere seconds, she has carved a corridor through the swamp with sheer firepower, forcing open a path for you.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Now's your chance! Move forward!", 4: '1'}

{3: "Her command is sharp and clear. Seizing the opening she carved, you break free from the remaining restraints. Finally, you have managed to reach the <phonetic=Dream Master's>girl's</phonetic> icy fingertips, and as you do, your fingers lock tightly around them."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiChongDongOpen.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen02.prefab', 2: '2'}
{2: "(Grab Nozomi's hand with all your strength)", 3: '422'}
{3: 'The instant your palms meet, the girl in the red dress floating above fires at the "door"—'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStorySugorokuScreen02.prefab'}

{1: '1', 3: 'After a while, the sludge from the door finally recedes, and you help the exhausted Dream Master back to the private room to rest.'}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: "I'm so sorry. This was supposed to be just an ordinary banquet. I never imagined... that those Nightmares would manage to break through the barriers of the Deep Dream.", 4: '1'}

{2: 'Nozomi', 3: 'The fault completely lies with me. This all happened because I failed to maintain control over this dream. I will take full responsibility for every guest who was caught up in this incident.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: 'That goes for you too, of course, since you came to my aid. Tell me, honored guest, what wish would you like to be granted?', 4: '1'}

{1: '1', 3: 'You turn around and spot the girl in red. That girl who should know this world better than anyone else is at the back right now, directing the guests who have regained their wits, getting them to treat the wounded and handle the cleanup.'}
{3: 'Strangely enough, despite the banquet nearly ending in catastrophe, the survivors seem calmer than before. Even that odd fervor that consumed them earlier has faded away.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1386.jpg', 3: '1', 4: '0', 5: '0.5'}
{1: '1', 3: "The Dream Master's shy voice pulls your attention back to her."}
{2: 'My wish is... to leave this dream.', 3: '482'}
{3: 'A flicker of surprise crosses her face—she who carries the weight of so many wishes.'}
{2: '...Can you make that happen?', 3: '484'}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: "Of course, I'd be more than happy to grant you that wish. Unfortunately, though... I myself can't leave this dream either.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The surprise on her face fades, replaced by a swirl of guilt, self-blame, and shame.'}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: 'I was given one purpose—to manage this place and grant wishes for everyone here. However, I was never given the means to leave... or to fight back against the Nightmares.', 4: '1'}

{2: 'Nozomi', 3: 'Oh, um... "Nightmares" are what we call those monsters roaming the hall. The Deep Dream gives birth to them, and then they would cross over the "door" to come here, hunting humans to sustain themselves.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: "I don't understand why this world's creator made such rules, but... if you could help me clear out those Nightmares, I might be able to gain more power...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Nozomi', 3: 'Maybe then I could help you leave this dream.', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Oh my, now that sounds like quite the straightforward mission. Count me in—I'll help you get this done.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'Somehow, Kurumi has gotten behind you without you noticing.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'We help you clear out the Nightmares, and you help us get back to reality. A deal most simple and easy to understand.', 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "What about you, human? Surely you won't say no, right?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She steps between you and the Dream Master, tilting her head with a playful stare.'}
{2: 'Of course.', 3: '502', 4: 'Welcome aboard, Kurumi Tokisaki.', 5: '502'}
{3: 'Kurumi grins, satisfied, while the weary Dream Mistress lets out an almost imperceptible sigh of relief.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Nozomi', 3: "Then I'd like you to head to the commercial district in Dream City. Many of my guests have fallen victim to the Nightmares prowling around there already.", 4: '1'}
{2: '(Nod)', 3: '507', 4: '(Turn to Kurumi and observe her reaction)', 5: '507'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "We'll do just that then.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She wraps up the negotiation just like that and heads straight out of the hall.'}

{3: 'The transmission is far from clear, garbled into barely legible noise. Nevertheless, the desperation of the three teammates trying to reach you comes through loud and clear.'}
{2: '(Try to respond to Gray Raven)', 3: '525'}
{3: 'You type out a detailed message reporting your status and location, but after an agonizingly long freeze, only a single message can be seen on the terminal: "Failed to send."'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: 'Is someone worried about you, perhaps?', 4: '1'}
{3: "The black-haired girl doesn't rush you. She waits until you've confirmed the message won't go through before quietly speaking up."}
{2: 'Yup. The three of them are all reliable teammates I can count on.', 3: '531', 4: "They're like family to me.", 5: '531'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Oh my, now isn't that nice?", 4: '1'}
{3: 'She tosses out a curt reply. A few seconds pass before she adds what sounds like a forced afterthought.'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "Please don't get me wrong. What I mean is...", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Kurumi Tokisaki', 3: "To have people waiting for you to come back... that's really something special.", 4: '1'}
{2: 'I understand.', 3: '538'}
{2: "Oh, right. I don't think I've introduced myself yet. My name is...", 3: '539'}
